{
  "name": "claudepad",
  "displayName": "claudepad",
  "description": "A notepad pane for Claude Code: notes per repo, per branch or global, that Claude can read, add to and tick off. Tags, due dates, search, pinned context, and NOTES.md or git-folder sync.",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "Noel Wilsson",
    "url": "https://github.com/nwilsson"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/nwilsson/claudepad",
  "repository": "https://github.com/nwilsson/claudepad",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "notes",
    "notepad",
    "todo",
    "productivity"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "editor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Editor for note links",
      "description": "The editor a note's path:line opens in: vscode (code -g), cursor (cursor -g) or jetbrains (idea --line).",
      "default": "vscode",
      "options": [
        "vscode",
        "cursor",
        "jetbrains"
      ]
    },
    "notesFolder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notes folder",
      "description": "A folder to keep notes in, one JSON file per project, instead of Claude Code's plugin store. Point it at a git-tracked or synced folder to have your notes on every machine. Absolute, or starting with ~/. Empty keeps them in the plugin store.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
